decisions.reason: Superyacht crew recruitment uses the existing crewing network and seafarer pool at low incremental cost, and nothing signals a shortfall against aspirations that would trigger search for other uses of its resources.
The Smart Academy quickly grew to six partner institutions, a result above aspiration, and it fits the firm's training centres and its push into integrated maritime solutions.
FuelEU monitoring is mandated by regulation, was delivered on time for all vessels, and protects client compliance, so it clearly meets aspirations and is close to the core offer.

The dashboard is integrated into the PAL software and supports the digital compliance strategy at low marginal cost, and the firm's growth gives it slack to carry the product while its value is still uncertain.
The cost simulator complements the dashboard within PAL and serves clients' FuelEU cost planning, so with available slack there is no reason to drop it despite limited evidence of results so far.
